description: Implementation of red-black tree operations including insertion, removal, rotation, and traversal functions for managing a self-balancing binary search tree.

methods.name: rb_insert
methods.description: Inserts a node into the red-black tree, maintaining balance and coloring rules.

methods.name: rb_remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the red-black tree, fixing tree properties post-deletion.

methods.name: z_rb_walk
methods.description: Traverses the tree in-order, applying a callback function to each node.

methods.name: z_rb_child
methods.description: Returns the child node of a given node on the specified side.

methods.name: z_rb_is_black
methods.description: Checks if a node is black.

methods.name: rb_contains
methods.description: Checks if a node exists within the tree.

methods.name: z_rb_foreach_next
methods.description: Provides the next node in in-order traversal using a stack-based iterator.
